turns.prompt: Walk me through what happens at each step of Discovery, and who does what.

replies.text: Checking the service blueprint for the Discovery phase...

In the service blueprint, **Discovery** is a `scenario` within the `Application` `phase`, mapped on the `Standard` (`happy`) `path`. All 34 matching `cell` rows are `live`, documenting how prospective tutors discover and enter the PLUS funnel today. 

Here is what happens across each `step`, broken down by actor and `lane`:

---

### Step 1: “Discovers PLUS”
The candidate encounters PLUS through one of five parallel discovery channels that all converge into the same interest funnel.

* **Prospective Tutor** (`Regular Tutor` `lane`):
  * Discovers PLUS via [word of mouth](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070103), [social media](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070203), the [marketing website](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070303), [on-campus activities](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070403), or [Handshake](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070503).
* **Frontstage Staff & Peers** (`Front Stage Actions` `lane`):
  * **Current & former tutors**: Tell prospective tutors about PLUS through personal referrals ([`cell`](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070104)).
  * **Tutor supervisor team**: Staffs a physical [on-campus booth](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=65fe259e-1f90-48fc-bc5b-27b998a5002d) at career fairs to answer questions face-to-face ([`cell`](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070404)).
* **Backstage Teams** (`Back Stage Actions` `lane`):
  * **Marketing team**: Creates and schedules social media recruiting campaigns ([`cell`](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070207)) using Figma ([`cell`](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070208)).
  * **Design & Dev teams**: Design sets messaging/layouts in Figma while Dev implements and ships changes to the [marketing website](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070306) via dev tools ([`cell`](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070307), [`cell`](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=b4f80b26-e2bb-454e-aa0f-e80d5c7b7a40)).
  * **Tutor supervisor team**: Posts job openings on Handshake based on partner school calendars and tutor-to-student ratio models ([`cell`](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070507)).
* **Key Touchpoints & Systems**:
  * [Campus posters](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070406), [Social media platforms](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070206), [Handshake employer profile](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070506), and the [Marketing website](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070306) (`tutors.plus`).

---

### Step 2: “Interested in joining PLUS”
The prospective tutor signals interest. Crucially, this submission is an interest capture—not a formal job application.

* **Prospective Tutor** (`Regular Tutor` `lane`):
  * Submits the [interest form](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070603) reached via Handshake or the website.
* **Touchpoints** (`Front Stage Touchpoints` `lane`):
  * [Google Form](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=e0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000616): Captures basic candidate details. Submitting this form unlocks the invitation to the required info session.

---

### Step 3: “Attends info session”
This is the primary screening gate of the scenario. Candidates must attend live before receiving the real application form.

* **Prospective Tutor** (`Regular Tutor` `lane`):
  * Attends the required [live info session](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=e0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000611).
* **Tutor Supervisor Team** (`Front Stage Actions` & `Back Stage Actions` `lanes`):
  * **Frontstage**: Hosts the session live on [Zoom](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=e0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000612) and shares the post-session form link directly with attendees ([`cell`](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=e0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000613)).
  * **Backstage**: Maintains presentation slide decks and logs live attendance ([`cell`](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=e0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000614)). Because the post-info-session form doubles as the candidate's first interview, attendance logging acts as the hard filter—unlogged or absent candidates cannot advance to the subsequent **Interview & Offer** `scenario`.

---
